title: Upscaler Torture, TSR High at 2160p output and 0.5 scale (GT-4 T1)

lines.name: TSR High, 2160p output at 0.5 (T1)
lines.reason: Not runnable at 2160p yet: the RTX 4080 SUPER machine's desktop runs at 125 % scaling and the UE editor in game mode is not DPI-aware there, so 3840x2160 requests recorded 3072x1728 (fullscreen) and 2560x1440 (windowed); a fullscreen launch made DPI-aware recorded 3840x2160. How the UE side gets 2160p (Epic's 'Allow High DPI in Game Mode' project setting, or 100 % scaling during the PQ sessions) is the lead's decision. Until then the report refuses these sets for the resolution mismatch. UE's internal resolution (screen percentage 50) is not verified either: no capture column or metadata records it, so a judged report refuses these sets until an observed source exists.
